chunks: May Allah have mercy on a servant who acts well in what is between him and his wife, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has given him authority over her and made him her guardian.

key_terms.الْقَيِّمَ: the one responsible for oversight and maintenance
key_terms.رَحِمَ: showed mercy; here, a prayer for Allah’s mercy
key_terms.نَاصِيَتَهَا: her forelock; an expression indicating authority over her

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about a husband's treatment of his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a husband should conduct himself with goodness and excellence toward his wife. It presents kind treatment within marriage as a matter deserving Divine mercy, while also acknowledging the husband's appointed responsibility over the household.
